h1: Custom Folding Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom folding caps in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for giveaways and events. Soft CTA: Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom folding caps are a practical choice for events and giveaways where portability matters. Unlike traditional structured caps, these fold flat for easy packing and storage, making them ideal for trade shows, charity runs, or welcome kits. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look. Polyester or cotton twill options offer durability and a comfortable fit.
heroAltText: Custom folding caps featuring embroidered logo on front, folded flat for portable storage
